shape: modelcontextprotocol/registry#1715: entry, version, checked_at, check (endpoint | package), state (alive | auth | transient | dead | unknown), evidence
updates: after each successful daily probe run; the monthly copies stay at /data/mcpcost-evidence-YYYY-MM.json.gz

checked_with.answered_protocol_version: evidence.protocol_version of each row: the version the server answered in initialize
checked_with.endpoint: initialize, then tools/list, over the transport the entry lists (streamable-http, else SSE), with no credentials; a 401 or 403 is read for its WWW-Authenticate header and OAuth metadata
checked_with.package: the same client in a container with the network off, after an install with the network on; the container has the newest 1.x SDK on the day of the run, so its requested version can be newer
